title: Sandbox does not forward GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION into container

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a bug where GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION is not forwarded into sandbox containers when GEMINI_SANDBOX=true. Reproduction steps, client version, root cause analysis, and target code references in sandbox.ts are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is a straightforward single-file edit in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts to include GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION in both Docker and LXC environment variable forwarding lists, alongside updating existing unit tests in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.test.ts.

summary.problem: The GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION environment variable is silently dropped when entering sandbox mode (GEMINI_SANDBOX=true).
summary.root_cause: packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts maintains explicit allowlists for environment variables to forward into Docker and LXC sandboxes. GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION was omitted from both forwarding routines.
summary.context: Without GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION forwarded into the container, requests to Vertex-compatible base URLs that rely on apiVersion fail with 404 ModelNotFoundError.

steps: Add an environment variable forwarding block for GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION in the Docker container launch args in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts.
Add GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION: process.env['GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION'] to the envVarsToForward object in LXC container setup in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.ts.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION is present in process.env, sandbox startup forwards --env GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION=<value> to the container runner.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/utils/sandbox.test.ts asserting that GOOGLE_GENAI_API_VERSION is included in docker spawn arguments when defined in process.env.
